import asyncio, time, json
import classic_panel as cp, classic_strategy as cs, classic_hand as hand
runs=json.load(open('runs.json'))
now=int(time.time()*1000)
async def go():
    import aiohttp
    cp.SES=aiohttp.ClientSession()
    for rid in (18,5):
        r=[x for x in runs if x['id']==rid][0]
        df=await cp.get_df_long(r['sym'],r['cfg']['tf'])
        for fwd in (True,False):
            P=dict(cs.PARAMS,**r['cfg'],sym=r['sym']); P['sim_from_ms']=0; P['hand_forward']=fwd
            tr=cs.pack(cs.simulate(df,now,P))
            print(rid,r['sym'],r['cfg']['tf'],'forward',fwd,'trades',len(tr),[(t.get('sig'),t['side'],t['p_in'],t.get('tp'),t['reason'],t['net']) for t in tr][:6])
asyncio.run(go())
print([ (x['id'],x['sym'],x['tf'],x['kind'],x.get('deleted')) for x in hand.load() if not x.get('deleted')])
P
